subject: columnFormIPM row cardinality in the live calculator
verdict: The live column form holds exactly one row per component. Its saved value is an array, but both rehydration paths read value[0]; the live form represents a second configuration as a second service. The engine therefore keeps failing closed on more than one row, and the coverage tracker no longer lists repeatable-rows as a blocker.

evidence.what: The recompute entry point reads only the first row
evidence.meaning: n is the saved value array (calculationComponents[id].value); h = n[0]; every later use (prices, configSummaryString: ee(h,u), initialState: {value: h}) is built from that single row.

evidence.what: The save converter preserves the array shape
evidence.meaning: The component state is one row, so a native save writes a one-element array.

evidence.what: Rehydrating a saved or shared estimate also takes row zero
evidence.meaning: The reset/convert-from-save path normalises the saved array to a single row before the component mounts.

evidence.what: The editor Update path is the save-and-share recompute
evidence.code: module 2970878 imports a=r(712); in its columnFormIPM branch: const e=(...).value; const t=i.get(k.mappingDefinitionName); ... const t=await Object(a.b)(r,n,k,e,l,m); ... c.calculationComponents[p]=t.state
evidence.meaning: Object(a.b) is ae. The 'Update estimate' button calls onSaveEstimate, which runs this branch, so the editor recompute and the save-and-share recompute are the same function.

evidence.what: The component UI renders one set of controls per declared row
evidence.code: class J ... createRows(e,t){const r=t||{}; ... i.forEach(...)} render(){const r=Object(h.t)(this.state.rows).map(e=>...)}
evidence.meaning: this.state.rows is keyed by row.selectorId (the definition's columns), not by instances, and the component has no add/remove control.

evidence.what: A repeatable mechanism exists, but only for whole cards
evidence.meaning: Card-level repeatables create separate component ids per instance. They are a different feature and are unused by the data plane.

liveObservations.conclusion: The editor keeps both rows in storage, prices row[0] only, and summarises row[0] only.
Reversing the rows flips the price from 9.00 to 1.50, so the live behaviour is positional row[0], not a sum and not a max/min.

liveObservations.how: Created in the live UI: AWS CodeBuild configured twice with 'Save and view summary', named axi-e2e ui-made rows probe, saved with Share. No hand-crafted payload.
liveObservations.conclusion: A real user's 'second row' is a second service with its own service id; each columnFormIPM keeps its definition id and a one-row array. Repeated component ids such as columnFormIPM_<uuid> do not appear.

engineDecision.rule: columnFormIPM takes exactly one row. More rows fail closed with UNSUPPORTED_INPUT, naming the live behaviour and pointing at this evidence.
engineDecision.reason: Publishing several rows would make the stored service cost differ from the live editor recompute, which is the differential oracle. Failing closed keeps every published number reproducible.
engineDecision.whatUsersDo: Add the service once per configuration, exactly as the live UI does.
